name: v0.3.44 — Dashboard “Add Receipt” button is back + brand login mascots
releaseNotes:
• Dashboard: the “Add Receipt” button is back — tap it to snap a photo, pick a screenshot from your gallery, or dictate a receipt (it was dropped in an earlier simplification).
• Login: the welcome avocado is now always one of OUR brand mascots, picked at random (the maracas dancer + happy / rich / relaxing moods).
• Receipts: the membership / loyalty number now auto-fills the Reward No field when you scan (Costco “Member”, Giant “Customer”).
• Receipts: a full-screen scan animation plays while a receipt is read — the maracas avocado + a sweeping magnifier + an animated status bubble.
• Receipts: capture options live behind one “Add Receipt” button (Take a photo / Pick from gallery / Voice).
